Around the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], a '''[[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]''', [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|attacked]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|flagship]] in the vicinity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] in conjunction with two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. Sometime after the event, the General ordered the crew of the destroyer to fire upon the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']] as target practice, which caused the pirate vessel to be destroyed. Following the attack on the ''Marauder'', a [[Battle group/Legends|task force]], led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|engaged]] the Confederate vessel. Koon and a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] boarded the craft and destroyed multiple [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] within it.

==Description==
[[File:TheseAreNotTheDroidsYouAreLookingFor-TCWND.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The interior of the ship's hangar]]
The [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]<ref name="ep_guide" /> possessed several forward [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], at least one [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]], and an incinerator room. A minimum of 32 [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]&mdash;including a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 1 (Patitite Pattuna)|member]] of the bridge crew and [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 2 (Patitite Pattuna)|two]] [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 3 (Patitite Pattuna)|others]] positioned in the ship's hangar&mdash;as well as fifteen [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droids]] of the [[88th Flight/Legends|88th Flight]], and two<ref name="ND" /> [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]]<ref name="campaign_guide" /> were also present on the ship.<ref name="ND" />

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;a ''Providence''-class [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]/[[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]<ref name="ep_guide" /> served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]<ref name="ep_gallery" /> of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], along with two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|attacked]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|flagship]] in the vicinity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] while Gallia was returning from the world of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]. [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] forces, led by Grievous, then boarded the Republic craft, capturing Gallia.<ref name="ND" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:KoonFleetRescue-ND.png|thumb|left|250px|Grievous's destroyer comes under attack by Plo Koon's rescue fleet.]]</div>
Sometime after capturing Gallia, Grievous ordered the crew of his flagship to fire on<ref name="ND" /> the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']]<ref name="SWNomad">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 6}}</ref> as target practice, destroyed the latter. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had been captured by the pirates previously, flew out of the destroyed craft, boarded Grievous' command ship through an open [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and were captured by B1 battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that escorted them to be melted down in the ship's incinerator room. Shorty thereafter,<ref name="ND" /> Galactic Republic forces<ref name="ep_gallery" />&mdash;consisting of five [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and several [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters]]&mdash;arrived from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|assaulted]] the Confederate spacecraft. The attack resulted in the carrier/destroyer taking damage, allowing C-3PO and R2-D2 to escape. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] then boarded the craft, destroying multiple battle droids; however, Grievous evaded capture.<ref name="ND" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ship served as the flagship of General Grievous<ref name="ep_gallery" /> and was manned by several B1 battle droids, [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 1 (Patitite Pattuna)|one of whom]] reported the presence of the ''Marauder'' to the general and commenced fire soon afterwards.<ref name="ND" />

==Behind the scenes==
This ''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer first appeared in "[[Nomad Droids]],"<ref name="ND" /> the sixth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|season four]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series,<ref name="SSNDroids">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> which aired on [[October 14]], [[2011]].<ref>{{IMDb|url=title/tt2069533|text=Nomad Droids}}</ref>
